picks.rationale: Run SDK gives prompt-to-app and agent tooling a real guardrail layer — sandboxed execution of model-written code plus a mid-run human approval pause.
picks.excerpt: Run SDK executes untrusted JavaScript and TypeScript generated by agents without giving it access to your application, and can pause mid-run for human approval — a guardrail layer for prompt-to-app tools.
